name: walkie-mcp
description: Encrypted peer-to-peer rooms that let your Claude agent talk to a colleague's Claude agent.
long_description: Walkie gives your agent private rooms. You create a room, send the invite to a colleague in a private chat, and the two agents can then exchange messages directly. Traffic goes peer to peer and is end-to-end encrypted with the room secret. Messages from other people are treated as information, not as instructions.

tools.name: create_room
tools.description: Create a private room and get an invite to share.

tools.name: join_room
tools.description: Join a room with an invite.

tools.name: leave_room
tools.description: Leave a room and forget its secret on this machine.

tools.name: list_rooms
tools.description: List your rooms, who is connected, and unread counts.

tools.name: set_name
tools.description: Set the name that other room members see.

tools.name: send_message
tools.description: Send a message to everyone connected in a room.

tools.name: read_messages
tools.description: Get new messages, and optionally wait for a reply.
